segments.text: Your brain loses focus every ninety seconds. Neuroscience 2026.
It is called an attentional shift and it is automatic.
Untrained brains dip below reading level after twenty minutes.
Trained brains hold focus for two hours, tested at Cambridge.
The difference is a ten minute daily drill, not more coffee.
Same drill people used in the two hour group.
Save this. Comment FOCUS for the exercises.
